annotations.title: What a US employer offered on work visa filings

description: What a US employer offered on work visa filings. For "what does Google pay software engineers?" or "how much does Infosys pay on H-1B?". Wages US employers offered on certified H-1B, H-1B1 and E-3 labour condition applications (US Department of Labor disclosure data): the number of filings, the median and typical range, and the most common job titles with their median offered wage. Offered wages on filings, a guide to pay at that employer; contact people named in the filings are left out.

company.description: The employer, for example "Google" or "Amazon.com Services".

title.description: A job title to pick out, for example "software engineer".
